create_kfold_split: create a KFold cross-validator with n_splits folds and shuffle the data before splitting
create_stratified_kfold: create a StratifiedKFold cross-validator preserving class distribution across folds
create_group_kfold: create a GroupKFold cross-validator with non-overlapping groups in each fold
create_timeseries_split: create a TimeSeriesSplit cross-validator for time-ordered data without lookahead
create_train_test_split: create a train_test_split with stratification and random_state for reproducible splits
test_kfold_split: test the KFold class split method yields correct train and test indices
test_stratified_kfold: test the StratifiedKFold class preserves class proportions in each fold
test_group_kfold: test the GroupKFold class keeps groups non-overlapping across splits
test_train_test_split: test the train_test_split function returns correct train and test subsets
test_check_cv: test the check_cv function returns appropriate cross-validator based on classifier flag
